purpose: Native-speaker approvals of Kiswahili message templates. A draft built from a template carries offer_lib.NATIVE_REVIEW ('Kiswahili draft: native-speaker review required before release.') and stays held until this file records an approval of that exact template version (docs/plans/vicoba-integration-plan.md, decision 3b: per template version, not per lead; user decision of 13 October 2026, 'Kiswahili first').
how_versions_work: A version is the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the template text and the fixed sentences it inserts (offer_lib.template_version). Any edit to the wording gives a new version, which needs a new approval. draft_master_messages.py and draft_run_messages.py read this file; draft_master_messages.template_versions() and draft_run_messages.government_template_versions() give the current versions, and the drafter's summary prints them.
how_to_approve: Append one entry to 'reviews' per template version: template_id, version, decision ('approved' or 'changes requested'), reviewer_role (the reviewer the user names; a role, never a personal phone or email), reviewed_on (YYYY-MM-DD) and notes. Then re-run draft_master_messages.py (master) or the government run's pipeline. Only 'approved' entries with a reviewer role and a date release a draft.

vicoba-group-request.use: VICOBA group first message (subject and body): a request for 10-15 minutes at a weekly meeting; no terms

vicoba-group-follow-up.use: VICOBA group follow-up 1: a short check-in

vicoba-group-close.use: VICOBA group follow-up 2: the close, then dormant until the next savings cycle

vicoba-group-offer.use: VICOBA offer message after the committee replies: the family offer (OF01, OF02, OF09) and the group rate (OF07) in the register's words

gov-vicoba-introduction.use: Government run: the ward community development officer's VICOBA introduction letter (kind vicoba_introduction), after the council's introduction
